intent: Repair the Shell tests failure introduced by the block_compulsive_opening split: test_security_hardening.sh grepped the entry script for code that the split moved into lib/cco_wrapper.sh.
scope: linux_configuration/tests/lib/security_apps.sh: tests 17 and 18 now search the entry script and its libs
Non-goal: test 19, which inspects this machine's live /usr/bin wrappers
changes: Tests 17 and 18 search block_compulsive_opening.sh plus lib/cco_*.sh instead of the entry script alone. Both assertions are about a FEATURE existing (the auto-close timeout config, and the launch_with_timer function); after the split that code sits one file over, so grepping only the entry script reported 'not found' for code that is present and working — a false failure. Searching the set restores the original intent and survives the next split.
The lib list is built with a loop and an -f test rather than a bare glob, so an unmatched pattern cannot enter the array as a literal string and no shellcheck suppression is needed.

verification.evidence: 'Auto-close timer configuration exists' and 'launch_with_timer function exists' both PASS. Passed: 18. The single remaining local failure is test 19 ('Compulsive block wrappers installed'), which inspects /usr/bin: signal-desktop and discord are not currently wrapped on this machine and beeper is not installed. That check is machine-state, was failing before this change, and is not what CI reported.
CI's only failing assertion was 'launch_with_timer function exists — Not found at expected location', in the arch-tests job. It was NOT the new lib/tests discovery step, which passed.

risks: The checks are still greps, so they prove the text exists rather than that the timer works. That was true before the split; broadening the search does not weaken them, and genuinely testing the launch path is the job of lib/tests/, which cannot execute it (it pkills live apps).
Test 19 remains red locally until the wrappers are reinstalled on this machine. Out of scope here and unrelated to the split.
rollback: git revert the commit; the two checks return to grepping the entry script only and will fail again while the split is in place.
